'''Tsorkeg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Tsorkeg and three other Jawas, [[Izzar]], [[Hadiir]] and [[Mnek]], worked as scrap merchants during the conflict.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tsorkeg was added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] as a vendor who sells customizatons for Cartel Market companions for Jawa Scraps on both Republlic and Imperial fleets.
